messages.subject: NIMBLE remote short course January 4-6
parts:
There are still spaces available for a remote NIMBLE short course, 4-6 January.  The course will run each day from 8am-1pm (North American Pacific time), i.e. 11am-4pm (Eastern time) and 5pm-10pm (Central European time).  

For more information and to register:
https://r-nimble.org/nimble-virtual-short-course-january-4-6-2023

We hope to see you there online.

Perry
